items.title: UI tests for Isaac's Racer UI
items.detail: Owner decision 2026-10-06: the merged Racer UI (RacerHud/Index/Stats/Settings/Rebirth, new RollShowcase) is the UI spec. ui-test-writer rewrites UiSpec/UiScenarios for it (old SpeedHud/AutoRaceButton/IndexUi/StatsUi/RollUi tests are obsolete). Then update CLAUDE.md HUD rules (Speed now bottom centre) and docs/ROLL_ANIMATION_CONTRACT.md, and run /compat-check. Blocks the green stamp for the money tree + workshop round.

items.title: Verify the roll animation (UI suite, harness, /compat-check)
items.detail: main carries the roll animation unverified. Run the full UI suite on the final design (decisions 4 and 6), fix RollToast and the Index/Stats panels until green, then the full harness and an ALL GREEN /compat-check. DONE 2026-10-05: /compat-check ALL GREEN (f11ddc2d32ad), pushed to main.

items.title: Mechanical Workshop: 7 plots in the spawn area
items.detail: Spec: docs/WORKSHOP_SPEC.md. Phase 1 (2026-10-06) IMPLEMENTED, NOT VERIFIED: spawn floor grown to 228 x 232 with the old floor kept as the hub, 7 plots (WorkshopConfig), each joining player gets the lowest free plot with a level-1 workshop, empty plots show EMPTY PLOT, server-side zone check pays idle Speed (BASE_RATE 1/s x Speed multi x W x Workshop points, same diminishing term as racing), WorkshopLevel saved in PlayerData v4. Next: full harness in Studio (`workshop`, `spawn_area`, `data`), world-tester walk check. Open: BASE_RATE, level prices, offline earnings.

items.title: Workshop phase 2: HUD line, level upgrades, offline earnings
items.detail: IN WORKSHOP +N Speed/s HUD line (ui-test-writer first), workshop levels bought with Money once the owner sets prices (placeholder: W x2, price x5 per level), offline earnings and a welcome-back screen (design doc: 25 %, 8 h cap).

items.title: Money upgrade tree
items.detail: Design: docs/UPGRADE_TREE_DESIGN.md. Phase 1 GREEN 2026-10-05 (`upgrades` 49/49). Phase 2 (2026-10-06) IMPLEMENTED, NOT VERIFIED: UpgradeService (BuyUpgrade, BestTrack, TurboCount), effects in Gacha/Car/Race/MoneyService, PlayerData v4, RollUi reads TurboCount/TurboEvery; test-writer's phase 2 tests written while Studio was offline, so no red run was seen. Next: run the full harness in Studio, then phase 3 (UI + world pad) and /compat-check.

items.title: Fix static_settle vertical jitter at rest
items.detail: Fails ~1 in 3 cold starts (up to 1.375 vs 0.5): the parked chassis gets periodic ~0.8 stud/s vertical kicks on its suspension. RollingDrag 1.0 did not fix it (it acts on the look axis). physics-tuner: spring/contact at rest in CarPhysics, through /car-loop.

items.detail: world-tester: some Hill upslope support tops are up to 0.17 studs above the road surface (Support12 under right-lane waypoint 20). Small suspension bumps; track-designer via /build-track.

items.detail: tools/collab.py + Team & branches tab: start feature/<handle>/<slug> from origin/main (form, TODO card Branch button, moving a card to Doing, /feature), Initiated-By trailers, background fetch, push / switch, every unmerged branch with initiator, committers, systems, overlap and merge conflicts with your work, Rojo/Studio warnings, handoff notes. People in data/team.json. Tested in a sandbox clone with a local origin.

items.title: Review and merge Isaac's studio/draft05-cars-ui (Draft05 cars + Racer UI)
items.detail: Isaac Li (@issacli), 2 commits on 2026-10-06, 2 ahead / 0 behind main. Adds 7 Blender cars (assets/studio/CarModels.rbxm), redesigned Racer UI under RollToast (8 UI modules + StarterGui.rbxm), Shared/CarAppearance (cosmetic model welded on the physics chassis; CarService applies it on spawn and on EquippedCar change), and default.project.json maps CarModels + StarterGui and disables 5 legacy client scripts. Not compat-checked (his handoff says so). Overlaps our uncommitted CarService, ProjectContext, README, todo.json; git conflict with current_progress.md. His branch does not touch src/client/UiTest, and UiSpec still expects the IndexUi / StatsUi / AutoRaceButton ScreenGuis whose scripts he disables, so the UI suite will likely fail until ui-test-writer updates it. Handoff: docs/DRAFT05_HANDOFF.md on his branch. MERGED into initial-import 2026-10-06 (conflicts only in notes files). Fixed on merge: Racer HUD turbo bar now reads the upgrade tree's TurboCount / TurboEvery. Next: ui-test-writer rewrites UiSpec for the Racer UI, then full /compat-check.

items.title: Codex dashboard integration
items.detail: Workspace-filtered Codex sessions, main/subagent timelines, local read/write API client and AGENTS.md. Seven integration tests passed; live Codex feed and board API verified.

items.title: Claude <-> Codex bus and per-change agent/model labels
items.detail: Reviewed the Codex dashboard merge. Added tools/dashboard/agent_bus.py (messages, status, context, Claude hook), presence panel and message thread on the Agents tab, agent+model chips on uncommitted files and commits (+ agent filter), Codex model/edits/commits in codex_activity.py, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/README docs. 13 dashboard tests pass; live API checked on port 8799.

items.title: Automatic bus delivery for Codex
items.detail: Claude receives bus messages via a hook; Codex only when it follows AGENTS.md and runs agent_bus.py context. If the Codex CLI's hook support covers session start / prompt submit, wire `agent_bus.py hook --agent codex` there. Also: edits made via shell commands (sed, heredoc, python rewrites) are not attributed; consider attributing via git diff snapshots per tool call.

items.title: Show roll rarity as odds
items.detail: After the current compatibility check passes and changes are pushed, change the roll animation label from rarity words such as Common/Rare to odds such as `1 in 10` or `1 in #`, using the rarity stat as the source.

items.title: Add an Upgrade slab outside each workshop
items.detail: After the current compatibility check passes and changes are pushed, place a clearly labeled `UPGRADE` slab outside each player's workshop area. Keep the presentation readable and visually integrated with the workshop.

items.title: Implement workshop upgrades with E interaction
items.detail: After the current compatibility check passes and changes are pushed, let the owner approach the Upgrade slab and press E to open an upgrade modal. Show the next workshop level and required Money; increase workshop Speed/s exponentially as level rises, with a correspondingly increasing cost. Define and document the exact progression before implementation.

items.title: Draft Track 3 as a short straight drag race
items.detail: After the current compatibility check passes and changes are pushed, begin Track 3: connect it from Track 02, keep it quite short, and make it a straight drag-race layout. Validate the connection, spawn/finish flow, and track rules.

items.title: Begin implementing the upgrade tree
items.detail: After the current compatibility check passes and changes are pushed, begin the upgrade-tree implementation: define the progression, costs, effects, persistence, and UI/world interaction. Coordinate with the workshop upgrade economy so costs and Speed/s effects do not conflict.

items.title: Add an aesthetic Race-area overhang for manual auto racing
items.detail: After the current compatibility check passes and changes are pushed, add a small overhang/canopy in the Race area where a player approaches to manually enter auto racing. Make it visually polished, readable as an interaction point, and consistent with the surrounding environment. Use existing Roblox assets or an available plugin only if needed after checking what is already in the project.

items.title: Move roll controls into the top-centre roll animation
items.detail: After the current compatibility check passes and the existing changes are pushed, remove the bottom-left/bottom roll and AUTO controls. Keep the compact roll animation at the top centre as the only entry point; clicking it opens the enlarged roll view where the AUTO option lives.

items.title: Add a top-down auto-racing camera setting
items.detail: After the current compatibility check passes and the existing changes are pushed, add a Settings toggle for Top-down view. When enabled during auto racing, keep the car visible from above; mouse-wheel zoom should smoothly change the camera height/perspective rather than switching to a ground-level chase view. Restore the normal camera when auto racing stops.

items.title: Theme Tracks 01, 02, and 03 with distinct palettes
items.detail: After the current compatibility check passes and the existing changes are pushed, give each track its own visual palette. Track 01 uses a classic red/grey road with checkered race accents; Tracks 02 and 03 use distinct themed palettes. Keep the palette data per track so future tracks can define their own themes.
